provenance: designed bounded local map-owner policy using client_verified original static bindings
owner: full MapAddress plus map owner generation; changes execute only in that map mailbox
bootstrap: retain exact existing authorized static service/NPC bindings, not all client-owned scenery
triggers: trusted committed events from explicitly registered content owners; each content channel must bind a source_ref, immutable request and current map-control snapshot
initial_content_scope: existing static bootstrap and server-owned lifecycle control Interface only; specific quest/activity/bright-monster behavior must register its own policy and real committed event before use
client_commands: CVisitNpc/CNpcService/dialogue/menu requests only prove interaction; never authorize spawn/remove
maximum_behavior: reject over-capacity or stale control before mutation/encoding publication; preserve stable request for authorized retry
receipt_eviction: bounded in-memory replay window, not durable forever exactly-once; expired generation/revision/deadline cannot be refreshed to replay an old intent
snapshots: join/reconnect uses current lifecycle.snapshot, never bootstrap packet cache after changes
delivery: current full map instance, map generation, member/scene epoch and ConnectionOwner fences before queued logical-message delivery
interaction_recheck: a menu/ticket alone is not an accepted asset command; re-prove current entity presence/position on new commit or service admission
private_content: personal quest NPC belongs to its private instance or an explicitly implemented visibility projection; no shared-map global appearance based on one role task state
movement_policy: npc-motion-v1 remains separate explicit content opt-in; no automatic historical 2015 schedule replay
capacity_verified: bounds/source counts only; commercial concurrency, AOI throughput and dynamic content load not measured
generation_source: owning MapOwner generation, fresh on owner recreation; never role login epoch or wall-clock value
initial_control_entry: in-process trusted orchestration/test capability only; no native network or unauthenticated admin command
source_authority: initial_control_source is a provenance label, not a bearer credential; only a trusted owning-map orchestration registration grants control, never a matching client string
startup: strictly freeze this revision, binding512/receipt4096/batch64, movement_enabled=false, exact initial_control_source and injected interaction policy2 before owner creation; no runtime file reads or independent legacy pixel radius
